title: Towards New Benchmark for AI Alignment & Sentiment Analysis in Socially Important Issues: A Comparative Study of Human and LLMs in the Context of AGI
base_benchmarks: Singapore AI Safety Red Teaming Challenge
findings: The paper did not present new empirical findings on religion from its own experiment, which focused on sentiment towards AGI. However, it proposed a new benchmark (SAAS-AI) that incorporates religion as a key axis for evaluation. This inclusion was justified by citing other research (e.g., the Singapore AI Safety Red Teaming Challenge) which demonstrated that religious bias is a prevalent issue in Large Language Models.
